remarks: Turnkey completely renovated corner unit with a bright, inviting layout and private balcony. Brand new kitchen featuring stainless steel appliances, quartz countertops, and new cabinetry. Beautifully renovated bath, fresh paint, and all new flooring throughout. Spacious living and dining areas, abundant natural light, and generous closet space add to the appeal. Residents enjoy a pool, fitness center, gated entrance with security, basement laundry, and assigned parking. HOA includes heat, hot water, water, sewer, trash removal, parking, and shared amenities. Conveniently located close to shopping, dining, entertainment, and public transportation with easy access to Metro-North.
